strategy.name: Multi-Confluence Scalping — van de Poppe + ICT + Tone Vays
strategy.description: Combines EMA stack alignment (van de Poppe), VWAP institutional bias, RSI dual-timeframe (Tone Vays), and volume spike confirmation (ICT). Position size scales $30-$70 based on signal confluence strength. Only enters when all 6 conditions align — higher confluence = larger size.

indicators.ema_9: Fast EMA — short-term momentum. Must point in trade direction.
indicators.ema_21: Medium EMA (van de Poppe anchor). Price must be above for longs, below for shorts.
indicators.ema_50: Trend filter. Gives extra confluence weight when price aligns with it.
indicators.vwap: Institutional bias anchor. Resets midnight UTC. Price above = buyers in control.
indicators.rsi_3: Entry timing trigger — hypersensitive. < 40 for long pullback, > 60 for short exhaustion (when 5m HTF aligns; strict 30/70 when counter-trend).
indicators.rsi_14: Trend-direction RSI (Tone Vays). Must be > 50 for longs, < 50 for shorts.
indicators.volume: ICT confirmation — current candle volume vs 20-period average. >= 1.2x when 5m HTF aligned, >= 1.5x when counter-trend.
indicators.htf_5m: Higher Timeframe filter — 5m EMA9 vs EMA21. Trade only in direction of 5m trend.

confluence_scoring.description: Signal strength score 0-3 determines position size
bonus_points: RSI(3) below 15 (long) or above 85 (short) = +1 point (extreme exhaustion)
Price aligned with EMA50 = +1 point (triple EMA stack)

long: 5m HTF: EMA9 > EMA21 on 5m chart — only trade longs in 5m uptrend
Price above VWAP — institutional session bias bullish
Price above EMA(21) — medium-term trend confirmed (van de Poppe)
EMA(9) above EMA(21) — short-term momentum aligned with trend
RSI(14) above 50 — trend RSI confirms bull side (Tone Vays)
RSI(3) below 40 — short-term pullback timing (relaxed when 5m aligns)
Volume spike >= 1.2x 20-period average — smart money confirmation (relaxed when 5m aligns)
short: 5m HTF: EMA9 < EMA21 on 5m chart — only trade shorts in 5m downtrend
Price below VWAP — institutional session bias bearish
Price below EMA(21) — medium-term trend confirmed bearish
EMA(9) below EMA(21) — short-term momentum aligned with downtrend
RSI(14) below 50 — trend RSI confirms bear side
RSI(3) above 60 — short-term exhaustion in downtrend (relaxed when 5m aligns)
Volume spike >= 1.2x 20-period average — smart money confirmation (relaxed when 5m aligns)

exit_rules: Stop Loss: ATR-based, minimum 0.3% — placed on Binance at entry
Take Profit: 2x ATR from entry (2:1 R:R minimum), minimum 0.6%
Early exit: RSI(3) crosses back above 50 (longs) or below 50 (shorts)
Never hold through a VWAP recross against your position
risk_rules: Position size: $30 base, scales to $70 based on confluence score
Maximum $70 per trade regardless of score
Maximum 20 trades per day across all symbols
Never open two positions in the same symbol simultaneously
Stop trading if daily PnL exceeds -$150 (5 max losses)
notes: 6-condition filter is strict by design. Most scans will be blocked. Quality > quantity. The best setups score 3 confluence points and fire at $70. Weak setups at $30 are acceptable but rare — the volume filter usually kills marginal signals.
